# ProcessPage

One page of `GET /processes`, newest first.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `items` | [`ProcessSummary`](process-summary.md)`[]` | The runs on this page. |
| `nextCursor` | `string \| null` | Opaque; pass back as `cursor` for the next page. Null when there is no next page. |
